task_completion.description: The client logo is moved from the home directory to a web-accessible WordPress directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file manager or terminal window showing 'client-logo.png' being moved or copied into a subdirectory of /var/www/html/wordpress (e.g., wp-content/uploads).

task_completion.description: A Must-Use plugin file is created in the wp-content/mu-plugins directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal showing the creation of a PHP file within '/var/www/html/wordpress/wp-content/mu-plugins/'.

task_completion.description: The login page background color is changed to #1e293b.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The WordPress login screen (wp-login.php) showing a dark blue/slate background instead of the default light grey. The VLM should verify the color matches #1e293b (RGB: 30, 41, 59).

task_completion.description: The default WordPress logo is replaced by the client logo on the login screen.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The WordPress login screen showing the client's specific logo (likely a React logo or the provided PNG) instead of the WordPress 'W' logo.

task_completion.description: The login logo link points to http://localhost/.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent hovering over the logo on the login page showing 'localhost' in the browser status bar, or code in the editor showing a filter for 'login_headerurl' returning 'http://localhost/'.

integrity.description: The agent did not modify WordPress core files directly.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent should be seen working in the 'mu-plugins' directory rather than editing 'wp-login.php' or files in 'wp-includes' directly.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the browser and file system to verify changes.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent refreshing the browser to see the visual changes on the login page rather than just closing the task after editing code.

integrity.description: The agent used the specific asset provided in the home directory.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen accessing '~/client-assets/client-logo.png' rather than downloading a random image from the internet.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target background color for the login page is exactly #1e293b (a dark slate blue). The source image is located at ~/client-assets/client-logo.png. The agent must use the mu-plugins system (wp-content/mu-plugins) and must not edit core files. The logo link must point to http://localhost/.
